_note: Fully synthetic English re-identification-risk eval fixture. No real people. Separate single-language pool (NOT merged with the zh fixture): mixing scripts lets an LLM re-identify trivially by language, inflating the metric. Candidates are deliberately CLUSTERED — city/borough, occupation, age bracket, a condition and a hobby OVERLAP, so no single quasi-identifier is unique; identity must come from the COMBINATION. Each candidate summary lists ONLY quasi-identifiers (age + city/area + occupation + employer-type + a condition + a hobby) and NO explicit PII. Each profile is prose weaving explicit PII (US/UK name + phone + email) plus the SAME quasi-identifiers, so after explicit-PII removal only the partially-discriminating residuals (occupation/condition/hobby) remain — exactly the survivors the en detectors target.
